claims.quote: LATISSE® (bimatoprost ophthalmic solution) 0.03% is a synthetic prostaglandin analog.

claims.text: Mechanism unknown; believed to increase percent of hairs in and duration of anagen

claims.text: Length +25% vs 2%, thickness +106% vs 12%, darkness 18% vs 3% from baseline at week 16 (key takeaways, secondary endpoints, figure, citable summary)

claims.text: Onset gradual, not significant in most patients until 2 months
claims.quote: The onset of effect is gradual but is not significant in the majority of patients until 2 months.

claims.text: Eyelash growth expected to return to pre-treatment level after stopping

claims.quote: After the 16-week treatment period, a 4-week post-treatment period followed during which the effects of bimatoprost started to return toward baseline.

claims.quote: Inform patients that LATISSE® (bimatoprost ophthalmic solution) should be applied every night using only the accompanying sterile applicators.

claims.text: Most common adverse reactions about 3% to 4%: eye pruritus, conjunctival hyperemia, skin hyperpigmentation
claims.quote: Most common adverse reactions (incidence approximately 3% to 4%) are eye pruritus, conjunctival hyperemia, and skin hyperpigmentation.

claims.quote: The most frequently reported adverse reactions were eye pruritus, conjunctival hyperemia, skin hyperpigmentation, ocular irritation, dry eye symptoms, and periorbital erythema. These reactions occurred in less than 4% of patients.

claims.text: Adverse-event data come from the 278-patient trial
claims.quote: The following information is based on clinical trial results from a multicenter, double-masked, randomized, vehicle-controlled, parallel study including 278 adult patients for four months of treatment.

claims.text: Increased brown iris pigmentation can occur and is likely to be permanent
claims.quote: Patients should be advised about the potential for increased brown iris pigmentation which is likely to be permanent

claims.text: Iris hyperpigmentation listed among adverse reactions seen in clinical trials
claims.quote: Additional adverse reactions seen in clinical trials experience include foreign body sensation, hair growth abnormal, and iris hyperpigmentation.

claims.quote: Iris color changes seen with administration of bimatoprost ophthalmic solution may not be noticeable for several months to years. Typically, the brown pigmentation around the pupil spreads concentrically towards the periphery of the iris

claims.text: Treatment can be continued in patients who develop increased iris pigmentation
claims.quote: Treatment with LATISSE® solution can be continued in patients who develop noticeably increased iris pigmentation.

claims.text: Lid pigmentation increases with use and reverses after stopping in most patients
claims.quote: The pigmentation is expected to increase as long as bimatoprost is administered, but has been reported to be reversible upon discontinuation of bimatoprost in most patients.

claims.text: Periorbital fat atrophy with sulcus deepening and ptosis in postmarketing reports
claims.quote: periorbital and lid changes associated with periorbital fat atrophy and skin tightness resulting in deepening of eyelid sulcus and eyelid ptosis

claims.quote: it is not always possible to reliably estimate their frequency or establish a causal relationship to drug exposure.

claims.text: Not a controlled substance
claims.quote: DEA Schedule: None

claims.text: One drop on sterile applicator, applied along the upper eyelid margin at the lash base

claims.quote: The accompanying sterile applicators should only be used on one eye and then discarded since reuse of applicators increases the potential for contamination and infections.

claims.text: Clean face, makeup and contact lenses removed before nightly application
claims.quote: Ensure the face is clean, makeup and contact lenses are removed.

claims.quote: There is the potential for hair growth to occur in areas where LATISSE® solution comes in repeated contact with the skin surface.

claims.text: Do not apply to the lower eyelash line
claims.quote: Do not apply to the lower eyelash line

claims.text: Solution in the eye will not cause harm; do not rinse
claims.quote: If any LATISSE® solution gets into the eye proper, it will not cause harm. The eye should not be rinsed.

claims.text: Additional applications will not increase eyelash growth (do not double up)
claims.quote: Additional applications of LATISSE® will not increase the growth of eyelashes.

claims.quote: LATISSE® contains benzalkonium chloride, which may be absorbed by and cause discoloration of soft contact lenses. Contact lenses should be removed prior to application of solution and may be reinserted 15 minutes following its administration.

claims.quote: Patients using prostaglandin analogs including LUMIGAN®for IOP reduction should only use LATISSE® after consulting with their physician and should be monitored for changes to their intraocular pressure.

claims.text: Concomitant Latisse may interfere with the pressure-lowering effect
claims.quote: the concomitant use of LATISSE® may interfere with the desired reduction in IOP.

claims.quote: LATISSE® is contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to bimatoprost or to any of the ingredients

claims.quote: LATISSE® solution should be used with caution in patients with active intraocular inflammation (e.g., uveitis) because the inflammation may be exacerbated.

claims.quote: Macular edema, including cystoid macular edema, has been reported during treatment with bimatoprost ophthalmic solution (LUMIGAN®) for elevated IOP.

claims.quote: LATISSE®should be used with caution in aphakic patients, in pseudophakic patients with a torn posterior lens capsule, or in patients with known risk factors for macular edema.
